1.consolidated_definition: med. Colapso, fallo. Efecto causado por insuficiencia cardiocirculatoria caracterizado por taquicardia, palidez, sudoración, etc. Anglicismo crudo, usual. Frase: estar en shock. “Cuando, a los pocos meses de ganarle a Ruiz, volvió a bajar a las 175 libras”, acotó, “su cuerpo entró en shock” (El Nuevo Día, 15-01-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Medical collapse or failure. Effect caused by cardiac insufficiency characterized by tachycardia, pallor, sweating, etc. Raw anglicism, commonly used. Phrase: to be in shock.

Note: "Ruiz" and "El Nuevo Día" are cultural references specific to Puerto Rico that have been preserved in the context of the translation.
